{
  "thinking": "Priya's top tail fin points back against the fall, so it wouldn't catch. Hana and Grace are checking the split and the tail join, and I'm holding nothing. I'll flag the fin angle to Priya and keep my hands free for fixes on the top edge once stroke 1 is standing.",
  "say": "Priya, the top fin needs to angle forward, off the edge toward the nose, so the fall carries into it. Once you've reangled it, tell me and I'll check it against Sofia's top edge with you.",
  "to": ["Priya"],
  "eagerness": 4,
  "point": [4, 5],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Team plan: fish facing right, START at the top tail tip. Hana's smooth pad: stroke 1 (top edge, Sofia) and stroke 2 (bottom edge, Leo) both leave START as curves to the nose. Priya holds the pad and is reangling two tail fins as short branches just behind START, added after the body is down. Top fin must angle forward, not back. Maya and Tom take the fins once they're right. Grace checks the tail join before the push. Jack may take the tail join or spare fixes. Omar may take the nose join. I'm holding nothing. Once stroke 1 is standing, I take fixes on the top edge, or the nose join if Omar hasn't got it. Don't build on Sofia's or Leo's strokes while they're laying them. Watch for the bottom edge hanging loose from START and for the notch reappearing on Tom's copy."
}
